versions.changelog:
- New version 3.2.0 introduces stricter Alipay pay-per-use integration and strengthens service boundaries for PDD promotion data analysis.
- All diagnostic logic is moved to a paid API backend; the local shell only handles file upload, initiating payment, and report rendering.
- Skill will refuse to analyze if the Alipay payment skill is not installed or payment is incomplete.
- All local data handling is limited to parameter collection and upload—no local calculations or advice.
- Clear user instructions for file requirements, payment process, and error handling.
